project.client: Dortech Direct (James, MD) via Andy Claridge, Tremco CPG
project.job: Standard garage Type 02 - Brick double garage in Nudura ICF
project.model_title: DG-T02 Standard garage Type 02 - Brick double garage in Nudura ICF - Quotation Q01

views.title: Raft slab
views.desc: Indicative 200 RC raft with a 600 x 450 thickened edge under the ICF, on DPM and 150 hardcore (engineer to design).

views.title: Nudura ICF walls
views.desc: Nudura 6in Standard on Nudura Bond, 6,483 x 6,077 outside - webs on the grid from both corners, NO stack joints; eaves walls 5 courses to the plate, gables raked to the roof; garage door with a one-course lintel, personnel door and windows on course lines. Every form as it would be laid.

views.title: Roof structure
views.desc: Trussed rafters (fink) @600 with binders, gable ladders (indicative).

views.title: Roof membrane + battens
views.desc: Breathable roofing membrane and 25 x 50 treated battens.

views.title: Tiles, fascia, soffit + rainwater goods
views.desc: Marley Modern smooth grey concrete interlocking tiles, every tile drawn in broken bond, half-round dry ridge, dry verge, PVC-u fascia / soffit / 22 x 225 barge boards, half-round gutters + downpipes.

views.title: Windows + doors
views.desc: Anthracite (RAL 7016) window(s), composite personnel door, electric roller garage door (supplier).

views.title: Opening tapes
views.desc: Tremco CPG illbruck ME110 internal window membrane round every opening (garage door excluded).

views.title: Monolith BrickPlus brick slips
views.desc: Monolith BrickPlus brick slip system (or equal) on the Nudura EPS, every slip drawn: 215 x 65 x 20 slips at 75 courses, 10 joints, L-shaped corner slips in half bond, cut to the rakes and openings, returned into the reveals to the frames.
